artworks.title: Fool and Two Bathing Women
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in an outdoor setting. The person on the left is partially seen from the waist up, reclining in a wooden tub with an arched opening above. They have intricately braided hair and a focused facial expression as they reach towards the person next to them. The middle individual is dressed in a long-sleeved garment and is depicted holding a man wearing a helmet and some sort of robe, who appears partially submerged in a circular tub. The third individual is fully shown, with curly hair. They are positioned to the right, standing on the ground, partially obscured by the tub. An elaborate decorative pitcher sits in the foreground, and a large jug is placed behind the middle figure. The background features a simple setting with a potted plant on a shelf and small rocks on the ground. The setting suggests an outdoor space with natural elements like a tree visible above the wooden structure.

artworks.title: The Penance of Saint John Chrysostom
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a landscape with a reclining female figure and child, along with a castle in the background. The image features a serene landscape with a nude female figure lying on her side next to a child standing beside her. The background includes trees, hills, and a castle under a partly cloudy sky. The engraving shows complex textures such as the stone of the castle, the shading of the human forms, and details of the natural landscape. The inscription at the top reads "S. Iohanes. Crisostomus."

artworks.title: The Shepherd
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated man reclined against a rock or fur-covered surface. His head is inclined to the left, resting on his left hand. He has curly hair and a beard. The man is partially clothed in a rustic garment and is surrounded by tall grass, rocks, and animal skin or fur. In the background, there is a landscape with a fortified town, towers, and mountains.

artworks.title: Profile Study of Two Horse Heads
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse's head with a geometric framework. The left side shows a diagrammatic representation of a horse's head framed by geometric lines and shapes, illustrating a method of constructing proportions. On the right side, there is a detailed depiction of the horse's head, with intricate mane curls and emphasis on musculature and features like the eye and nostrils.

artworks.title: Two Profile Studies of a Man's Head
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a man's head and neck in profile. The man is facing right with a grid structure on the left side displaying the same profile. His face features include a slightly pronounced brow, straight nose, and full lips. He has short hair with visible texture lines. He is depicted without clothing except for a faint line at the base of his neck. There is no jewelry or objects in the image. The background has parallel lines, with text reading "EINES MANNES HAVPT" above and a shield with "1542" and "HsB" between the two profiles.

artworks.title: Two Profile Studies of a Woman's Head
artworks.description: The image displays two side profiles of a head, one on the left and another on the right. The left drawing shows a head with facial features inside a grid system. The right drawing depicts a detailed profile of the same head, highlighting the facial features and hair texture. The profile shows a clean-shaven face, a straight nose, and defined lips, with short slightly wavy hair. The head and part of the neck are visible without clothing. The background has a shaded, cross-hatched texture, and there is text at the top that reads "EINES WEIBES HAUPT." At the bottom right corner, the date "1542" and the initials "ISB" are inscribed.

artworks.title: Three Medals with Portraits
artworks.description: Three portraits are displayed horizontally. Each is a bust-length profile of different individuals within circular frames. The left portrait shows a man facing right with closely cropped hair and a sturdy neck. His features include a prominent nose and distinct lips and chin. He wears a garment with a collar, and the frame includes the text "Ulrich Gebhardt." In the middle portrait, another person faces right wearing a tight headdress and high-collared top. The right portrait depicts a man facing right with a pointed beard and styled hair, wearing a fur-collared garment. None wear jewelry. The background features textured surfaces within the circular frames and surrounding area.

artworks.title: Ornament with a Couple of Tritons Blowing Horns
artworks.description: This is an illustration of two mythological creatures playing instruments. The image shows two mirrored satyr-like figures facing each other, each playing a wind instrument, with a vase-like object between them. Their bodies are detailed with leaf-like textures and their wings are prominently displayed. Floral motifs and intricate scrollwork decorate the borders. The drawing is detailed with precise linework and shading, adding depth to the figures and decorative elements.

artworks.title: Three Medals with Coats of Arms
artworks.description: The image shows three heraldic shields with intricate designs. The shields are adorned with decorative elements and are displayed in circular borders horizontally. The left shield features two stylized creatures, the center shield depicts a lion, and the right shield includes a horn symbol. Acanthus leaves frame each shield design.

artworks.title: Ornament with Eagle and Two Genii
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two cherubs and a griffin with foliage. The image shows two cherubic figures on either side of a griffin. The cherubs have curly hair and small wings, and are in dynamic poses, each holding curved stems or branches. There is intricate foliage in the background. The line work and shading suggest a finely crafted engraving or etching, highlighting textures of feathers, skin, and leaves. The composition is balanced and detailed, blending mythological and fanciful elements.

artworks.title: Ornament with Female Demon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged central creature flanked by two fantastical beasts. The central figure is a winged entity holding onto swirling foliage that connects to the creatures on either side. The beasts have elongated necks, clawed feet, and dragon-like appearances. The background features engravings that create depth and texture, contributing to the interplay of the figures.

artworks.title: Three Medals with Coats of Arms
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three heraldic crests. The crests are circular and feature intricate designs with emblems and ornate flourishes. The left crest shows a shield with diagonal lines and foliage, topped with a helmet adorned with plumes. The central crest also has a shield with varied patterns, flanked by two helmets, each surmounted by unique crests. The right crest features a unicorn atop a helmet over a shield that bears an image of a mythological creature, encircled by detailed scrollwork. The background is shaded, creating contrast with the lighter shields. The initials "IsP" are present on the lower left.

artworks.title: Mask Held by Two Genii
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two cherubs holding up a crest-like emblem with a face at the center. The central focus of the image is the crest-like emblem held by the cherubs, which features a stylized face. The face appears to be a grotesque mask or a Green Man motif, with foliage extending from its mouth and wild, flowing hair. The cherubs are depicted in a classical style, with detailed rendering of their wings and youthful features. They are positioned symmetrically on either side of the emblem. The background features intricate scrollwork and leafy motifs. This work consists of fine lines and shading, indicative of a detailed etching or engraving style.

artworks.title: Genius with Alphabet
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 4.4 × 7.9 cm (1 3/4 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure with scrolling ribbons bearing letters. The image depicts a cherubic winged figure from the back, holding onto swirling ribbons that float through the air. The ribbons are inscribed with letters of the alphabet, intricately wrapped around the figure. The background is richly textured with lines. The figure appears dynamically posed with detailing in the feathers of the wings and curls of the hair. The letters on the ribbons are written in a classic serif style.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel with a Large Bearded Mask
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mask wrapped in leaves. The central feature is a human-like face with exaggerated and stylized features. The face is crowned with an ornate headdress made of leaves. The expression is open-mouthed and somewhat solemn, with large ears and an elongated chin that blends into leaf-like forms extending outward. The surrounding area is filled with intricate detailing of leaves and vines that twist and intertwine, creating a textured background. The overall effect is decorative and slightly surreal, showcasing the artist's detailed line work and imaginative flair.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel with a Large Bearded Mask
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a face surrounded by ornate foliage. The central element is a face integrated into a decorative array of swirling leaves and tendrils. The composition is detailed with lines and shading, creating depth and texture in the foliage that frames the face. The drawing conveys symmetry and balance, typical of decorative arts from the Renaissance period. The ornamental elements have a fluid, organic quality, blending vegetal forms with the human-like face.

artworks.title: Ornament with Three Satyrs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical creatures holding ornate scrolls. The image features a central figure with the body of a human and the legs of an animal, holding two large leafy scrolls. Alongside this figure are two other creatures resembling satyrs with goat-like features, each playing a musical instrument. These creatures are intricately detailed with fur-like etchings, and the leafy scrolls showcase detailed patterns and textures. The background is filled with a stippled texture that contrasts with the finely engraved outlines of the figures and foliage.

artworks.title: Ornament with a Vase Between Two Genii
artworks.description: This is a drawing of ornamental motifs featuring putti and foliage. The image depicts two winged putti flanking a central urn or pedestal, with acanthus leaves and scrolls entwined around them. Each putto is positioned on either side, facing the urn with their bodies slightly turned towards it. The detailed engravings create a sense of depth and texture within the intricate patterns.

artworks.title: Ornament with a Vase Between Two Genii
artworks.description: This is a drawing of ornamental cherubs flanking a decorative urn. The drawing features two cherubic figures on either side of an intricately designed urn with elaborate scrollwork and foliage. Each cherub appears to be holding onto a circular garland that loops around and merges with the detailed vegetal motifs. The urn is positioned centrally, embellished with stylized leaves and elegant curves that enhance the symmetry of the composition. The background is shaded to emphasize the figures and create depth. The overall style suggests a classic or Renaissance influence, emphasizing detailed lines and shading to enhance the ornamental craftsmanship.

artworks.title: Ornament with Male Half Figure Between Two Genii
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative panel with mythological elements. The composition includes a central figure resembling a mythological or grotesque face with foliage extending from its beard. On either side are two cherubic winged children, or putti, interacting with surrounding ornate foliage and scrollwork. The drawing showcases swirling vines, leaves, and floral motifs in a symmetrical design. The etching reflects a Baroque or Renaissance ornamentation style known for its detailed decoration.

artworks.title: Ornament with Palmette and Two Dophin Heads
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and symmetrical shapes, creating a sense of motion. There are curling tendrils, ornate foliage, a motif with ribbed, fan-like shapes, trumpet-like forms, and fantastical, dragon-like creatures with elaborate details. The composition is in a monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: Ornament with Two Genii Riding on Two Chimeras
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a symmetrical ornamental design featuring cherubs and fantastical creatures. The central part of the drawing presents two cherubic figures, each with detailed feathered wings, interacting with goat-like mythical creatures. These creatures have curled horns and serpentine tails. The scene is bordered with swirling acanthus leaves and spirals that adorn the composition. The piece is intricate and rendered in fine detail, emphasizing the contrast in texture between the smooth bodies of the cherubs and the scaled, curled motifs of the background and mythical creatures. The artistic style is reminiscent of Renaissance engravings with elaborate detailing and classical themes.

artworks.title: Triumphal Procession of Putti
artworks.description: This is a drawing of cherub-like figures involved in a procession or festival scene. The image shows a group of cherubic, winged figures, some adorned with laurel wreaths, pulling a chariot. Two figures are seated within the chariot, possibly holding a scepter or staff. Others appear to be playing musical instruments like trumpets. The figures have a playful and lively demeanor, and their anatomical depiction suggests a classical or Renaissance influence. The overall style is reminiscent of Renaissance etchings or engravings, with intricate details and expressive lines.

artworks.title: Double Cup with Two Genii Riding on Dolphins
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate ornamental design with two putti. The image features a highly detailed and symmetrical composition centered around an elaborately decorated urn or vase. The upper half is adorned with intricate floral and foliate motifs, with graceful curves and swirling patterns. Below the vase, two putti are depicted supporting the structure. These figures are rendered with a sense of weight and volume. The entire composition is framed by more scrollwork and decorative elements. The year 1526 and the initials "ISP" are inscribed at the bottom center of the drawing.
